changelog: Investigated: a report of getFibBreakdown() (v3.9.2) rendering every bucket at n=1 on live did not reproduce — the exact, unmodified controller was run against a real MariaDB instance seeded with data matching the report's own numbers, in three scenarios (single Fib variable, two strategies each with their own Fib Level variable, no Fib variable at all), and every one produced the correct merged result. git history also confirms v3.9.2 was never committed or deployed. See CLAUDE.md for the full writeup and the generated SQL provided for live comparison

Fix: a blank/unanswered trade_variables value is no longer its own chart/table bucket — it's now treated the same as having no answer at all and excluded, since a single blank trade rendering as a 100%-confident bar was the same misleading artifact the sample-size guard exists to prevent
Add: fib_coverage (trades with a recorded value vs. all closed trades in scope) returned from get_stats and shown as a caption line under the chart/table instead of as a bucket

Fix: non-conclusive (low-n) buckets now use a visibly distinct treatment instead of a subtly lighter shade — a diagonal-hatch pattern on the Dashboard chart bars, italic + a leading '≈' on the Statistics table cells — since a muted-but-solid bar still read as normal data, just deemphasized
